description: This Kotlin file defines classes and functions for generating and updating project dependency graphs using Mermaid diagrams within a Gradle build environment. It includes classes for graph data collection, graph rendering, and Markdown file updates, as well as associated enums and extension functions.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: A class that builds a dependency graph of Gradle projects, representing project plugins and dependencies for visualization.

classes.name: PluginType
classes.description: An enum class defining types of plugins and their visual styles for graph rendering.

classes.name: GraphDumpTask
classes.description: A Gradle task that generates a Mermaid-formatted dependency graph and legend from project data.

classes.name: GraphUpdateTask
classes.description: A Gradle task that updates a Markdown file with the generated Mermaid graph and legend.

methods.name: configureGraphTasks
methods.description: Configures and registers the graph dump and update tasks within a Gradle project.
